articles.title: Angela Kessler, 64, Parish Bookkeeper
articles.deck: Friends remember Angela Kessler for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Canal Park. Born in Canal Park in the years after the war, Angela Kessler spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Angela Kessler died in April at home on Franklin Court, at the age of 64.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foxglove Heights Neighbors in his or her name.

body: Councilmember Simone Demetriou asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $3,400.

articles.title: Then & Now: Harbor Court in 1986 and Today
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1986 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Harbor Court from the corner of Locust Lane.

Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal. Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
